about: Finer topics under the bank's patterns. A problem is labeled with one or two of these, primary first. Patterns not listed here are fine enough on their own: sweep-line, monotonic-queue, tree-bfs, topo-sort, mst, dp-interval, dp-bitmask, dp-state-machine. Each signal says what in a problem points to the topic.

topics.name: Complement lookup
topics.signal: While scanning, look up a needed partner (target minus x, a seen prefix) in a hash map of earlier values.

topics.name: Frequency counting
topics.signal: Count occurrences to compare multisets or find the most or least common items.

topics.name: Group by canonical key
topics.signal: Items are equal under some normalization (sorted letters, a tuple of counts), so bucket them by that key.

topics.name: Set membership
topics.signal: Existence checks in a hash set, such as starting a run only where x-1 is absent.

topics.name: Array as its own hash
topics.signal: Values lie in 1..n, so mark by sign or swap each value into its own index for O(1) space.

topics.name: Opposite ends
topics.signal: Pointers at both ends of a sorted array or string move inward by a rule (pair sum, container, palindrome).

topics.name: Fast and slow
topics.signal: Two speeds over a list or sequence: find a cycle, the middle, or the nth from the end.

topics.name: Read and write pointers
topics.signal: Compact or partition in place with a write index trailing a read index (remove duplicates, move zeroes, colors).

topics.name: k-sum
topics.signal: Sort, fix one or more values, then two pointers for the rest, skipping duplicates.

topics.name: Walk two sequences
topics.signal: Advance through two sorted sequences together: merge, intersect, or check a subsequence.

topics.name: Fixed-size window
topics.signal: The window is exactly k long; add the new element and drop the old one each step.

topics.name: Longest valid window
topics.signal: Grow right, shrink left only when the window breaks a rule; maximize its length.

topics.name: Shortest valid window
topics.signal: Once the window satisfies the rule, shrink left while it still does; minimize its length.

topics.name: Count windows
topics.signal: Count subarrays meeting a rule, often exactly(K) = atMost(K) - atMost(K-1).

topics.name: Range sums
topics.signal: Precompute prefix sums (1D or 2D) so any range total is a subtraction.

topics.name: Prefix sum with a hash map
topics.signal: Count or find subarrays with a given sum or remainder by storing earlier prefix values.

topics.name: Difference array
topics.signal: Many range updates, read once at the end: add at start, subtract after end, then prefix-sum.

topics.name: Left and right passes
topics.signal: Combine a prefix pass and a suffix pass, such as product except self or max-to-the-left arrays.

topics.name: Lower and upper bound
topics.signal: First or last position meeting a condition in a sorted array.

topics.name: Rotated array
topics.signal: A sorted array rotated at an unknown pivot; decide which half is sorted.

topics.name: Sorted matrix
topics.signal: Search a matrix whose rows and columns are sorted, as one array or from a corner.

topics.name: Search on a property
topics.signal: No sorted order, but a monotone property splits the array (peak element, bad version).

topics.name: Partition two arrays
topics.signal: Binary search a cut across two sorted arrays, as in the median of two sorted arrays or kth across them.

topics.name: Search the answer with a check
topics.signal: Minimize the maximum (or maximize the minimum): binary search the answer and test it greedily (ship in D days, Koko).

topics.name: Kth by counting
topics.signal: Binary search a value and count how many items are at most it (kth smallest in a matrix or of pair distances).

topics.name: Custom comparator
topics.signal: The answer depends on sorting by a non-obvious key or comparator (largest number, reorder logs).

topics.name: Counting and bucket sort
topics.signal: Bounded values or frequencies allow O(n) bucketing (top k by buckets, maximum gap, h-index).

topics.name: Quickselect
topics.signal: Find the kth element or partition around it without fully sorting.

topics.name: Merge intervals
topics.signal: Sort by start and merge overlaps, or insert one interval into a sorted list.

topics.name: Greedy by end
topics.signal: Sort by end time and keep the earliest finishing (non-overlapping intervals, arrows, max meetings).

topics.name: Count overlaps
topics.signal: How many intervals overlap at once (meeting rooms, car pooling): sort endpoints or use a heap.

topics.name: Bracket matching
topics.signal: Match opening and closing symbols, or track depth and validity of nesting.

topics.name: Evaluate nested expressions
topics.signal: Calculators, RPN, decode string: push context on open, combine on close.

topics.name: Stack as history
topics.signal: Later items cancel or modify earlier ones (asteroid collision, backspace, simplify path).

topics.name: Next greater or smaller
topics.signal: For each element, the next or previous element that is greater or smaller (daily temperatures).

topics.name: Spans and contributions
topics.signal: Each element's reach left and right gives areas or counts (largest rectangle, sum of subarray minimums).

topics.name: Pop to build the best sequence
topics.signal: Build the smallest or largest result by popping worse earlier choices (remove k digits, smallest subsequence).

topics.name: Reverse links
topics.signal: Reverse the whole list, a sublist, or k-groups by rewiring next pointers.

topics.name: Merge, split, reorder
topics.signal: Merge sorted lists, partition around a value, or split and interleave halves, usually with a dummy head.

topics.name: Clone or flatten
topics.signal: Deep copy with extra pointers, or flatten nested lists, using a map or interleaved copies.

topics.name: Combine children
topics.signal: A node's answer comes from its children's results (height, diameter, balanced, subtree checks).

topics.name: Pass state down
topics.signal: Carry depth, bounds or the path so far from parent to child (validate BST by range, good nodes).

topics.name: Path sums
topics.signal: Root-to-leaf or any-node paths: return one branch upward and update a global best (max path sum).

topics.name: Build or serialize
topics.signal: Construct a tree from traversals, or encode and decode one.

topics.name: Lowest common ancestor
topics.signal: Find where two nodes' paths from the root diverge.

topics.name: BST inorder order
topics.signal: Inorder traversal is sorted: kth smallest, validate, recover swapped nodes.

topics.name: Navigate a BST
topics.signal: Go left or right by comparison to search, insert, delete, or trim to a range.

topics.name: Prefix lookup
topics.signal: Insert words and query prefixes or whole words (autocomplete, replace words).

topics.name: Trie with DFS
topics.signal: Search many words at once over a board or within words (word search II, concatenated words).

topics.name: Bitwise trie
topics.signal: Store numbers bit by bit to find the maximum XOR pair.

topics.name: Top k
topics.signal: Keep the k best seen so far in a size-k heap.

topics.name: K-way merge
topics.signal: Merge k sorted lists or rows, or find the kth smallest across them.

topics.name: Two heaps
topics.signal: Keep a running median or balance with a max-heap and a min-heap.

topics.name: Schedule by heap
topics.signal: Repeatedly take the cheapest, earliest or most frequent available item (task scheduler, IPO, reorganize).

topics.name: Connected components
topics.signal: Count or label groups with DFS or BFS over an adjacency list.

topics.name: Fewest steps by BFS
topics.signal: Unweighted shortest path where each move costs one (word ladder, open the lock).

topics.name: Multi-source BFS
topics.signal: Start BFS from many sources at once and spread in levels (rotting oranges, walls and gates).

topics.name: Cycle detection
topics.signal: Detect a cycle with three-color DFS in a directed graph, or parent tracking in an undirected one.

topics.name: Two-coloring
topics.signal: Split nodes into two groups with no edge inside a group.

topics.name: BFS over states
topics.signal: A node is a whole state (position plus keys, a mask, a board), and BFS explores state changes.

topics.name: Flood fill
topics.signal: DFS or BFS over cells to mark regions (number of islands, max area).

topics.name: Start from the border
topics.signal: Search inward from edge cells to find what is or isn't reachable (surrounded regions, Pacific Atlantic).

topics.name: Union-find connectivity
topics.signal: Merge sets as edges arrive and ask if two items are connected (redundant connection, provinces).

topics.name: Union by shared key
topics.signal: Union items that share an attribute (accounts merge, similar strings, equations).

topics.name: Offline unions
topics.signal: Sort edges and queries, then union in order to answer queries (limited path lengths, Kruskal-like).

topics.name: Dijkstra
topics.signal: Nonnegative weights: pop the closest node from a heap (network delay, path with minimum effort).

topics.name: Limited edges
topics.signal: Cheapest path with at most k edges: Bellman-Ford rounds or BFS with a step count.

topics.name: All pairs
topics.signal: Distances between every pair: Floyd-Warshall on a small graph.

topics.name: Subsets
topics.signal: Include or exclude each element, skipping equal neighbors when there are duplicates.

topics.name: Permutations
topics.signal: Order matters: a used[] array or swapping, with duplicate skipping.

topics.name: Combination sum
topics.signal: Choose items to hit a target with rules on reuse, pruning when over.

topics.name: Constraint placement
topics.signal: Place items under constraints and undo on conflict (n-queens, sudoku).

topics.name: Grid path search
topics.signal: DFS on a grid marking visited and unmarking on return (word search).

topics.name: Partition a string
topics.signal: Cut a string or array into valid pieces (palindrome partitioning, IP addresses, word break II).

topics.name: Take or skip
topics.signal: dp[i] chooses between using item i or not, from the last one or two states (house robber, climbing stairs).

topics.name: Best ending here
topics.signal: Track the best subarray ending at each index (max subarray, max product).

topics.name: Increasing subsequence
topics.signal: Longest increasing or chained subsequence, O(n^2) or patience sorting with binary search.

topics.name: Count ways
topics.signal: Number of ways or decodings, summing smaller states (decode ways).

topics.name: Split points
topics.signal: dp[i] tries every last cut j < i (word break, min cuts, perfect squares).

topics.name: Reach and minimum steps
topics.signal: Fewest steps or cheapest cost to reach the end (jump game II, min cost tickets).

topics.name: Grid paths
topics.signal: Count or minimize paths moving only right or down, with obstacles or costs.

topics.name: Largest square or rectangle
topics.signal: dp of the biggest shape ending at each cell (maximal square).

topics.name: Two strings
topics.signal: dp[i][j] over prefixes of two strings (LCS, edit distance, interleaving, distinct subsequences).

topics.name: Palindromes
topics.signal: Palindromic substrings or subsequences by expanding or by interval dp.

topics.name: Pattern matching
topics.signal: Match with wildcards or regex operators like * and ?.

topics.name: 0/1 knapsack
topics.signal: Each item used at most once to reach a sum or capacity (partition equal subset, target sum).

topics.name: Unbounded knapsack
topics.signal: Items can be reused (coin change, combination sum IV).

topics.name: Node states
topics.signal: Each node returns a few states such as taken or not (house robber III, cameras).

topics.name: Rerooting
topics.signal: Answer for every node as root by reusing a first DFS (sum of distances in tree).

topics.name: Sort, then pick
topics.signal: After sorting, a simple local choice is optimal (assign cookies, boats, two city scheduling).

topics.name: Farthest reach
topics.signal: Track the farthest point reachable so far (jump game, gas station).

topics.name: Two passes
topics.signal: A left-to-right pass and a right-to-left pass, then combine (candy).

topics.name: Running balance
topics.signal: A running counter or balance decides each step (parentheses to add, lemonade change).

topics.name: Build the answer
topics.signal: Build the result piece by piece, always taking the best safe piece (reorganize string, monotone digits).

topics.name: XOR cancels
topics.signal: Pairs cancel under XOR (single number, missing number).

topics.name: Bit tests and counts
topics.signal: Count, test, set or clear bits (power of two, counting bits, reverse bits).

topics.name: Masks as subsets
topics.signal: Enumerate or represent subsets as bitmasks.

topics.name: Number theory
topics.signal: GCD, primes, divisibility, modular arithmetic.

topics.name: Digits and overflow
topics.signal: Work digit by digit, watching the 32-bit range (reverse integer, palindrome number, atoi).

topics.name: Counting formulas
topics.signal: Count with nCr, Pascal's triangle or inclusion-exclusion.

topics.name: Geometry
topics.signal: Points, lines, rectangles, areas and angles.

topics.name: Find the formula
topics.signal: Spot a pattern or closed form instead of simulating (bulb switcher, nim).

topics.name: Numbers as strings
topics.signal: Add or multiply numbers stored as strings, arrays or lists.

topics.name: KMP and Z
topics.signal: Prefix-function or Z-array for pattern search and repeated structure.

topics.name: Rolling hash
topics.signal: Rabin-Karp hashes to compare substrings fast (longest duplicate substring).

topics.name: Segment tree
topics.signal: Range queries with updates (sum, min, max), possibly lazy.

topics.name: Fenwick tree
topics.signal: Prefix sums with point updates, or counting inversions by value.

topics.name: Ordered set
topics.signal: A balanced tree or sorted container answers floor, ceiling or rank as items arrive.

topics.name: Count during merge sort
topics.signal: Count pairs across halves while merging (reverse pairs, count of smaller numbers after self).

topics.name: Split and combine
topics.signal: Solve halves recursively and combine (different ways to add parentheses, sorted array to BST).

topics.name: Caches
topics.signal: LRU or LFU: a hash map plus an ordered list for O(1) updates.

topics.name: Iterators and streams
topics.signal: Process data as it arrives or one item at a time (moving average, peeking iterator).

topics.name: Structure with fast operations
topics.signal: Support each operation in O(1) or O(log n) (min stack, randomized set, time map).

topics.name: Matrix walks
topics.signal: Spiral, rotate, transpose or diagonal traversal of a matrix.

topics.name: Apply rules step by step
topics.signal: Follow given rules exactly, tick by tick (game of life, robot moves, text justification).

topics.name: Parse and format strings
topics.signal: Parse or rebuild text by a fixed format (compress, zigzag, validate IP).
